title: Local-Unitary Rigidity and Quantitative Rounding for Stabilizer AME States
description: For every prime power q and m≥2, this preprint proves that every product unitary mapping one stabilizer AME(2m,q) state to another is Clifford on each party. Any (m+1)-party marginal determines the complete local Weyl frame, and the transition maps between those frames classify local-unitary equivalence and imply factorwise rigidity for transversal encoder conversions. A leakage-aware three-region cleaning and Weyl–Fourier argument gives 8ε Clifford rounding throughout the certified radius Θ(min{p⁻¹,q⁻¹ᐟ²,n⁻¹ᐟ²}); at a larger dimension-dependent radius the remaining difficulty is control of the stabilizer character, equivalently the product-Pauli correction.
